sar.narrative: Suspicious activity is indicated by a cluster of ten cards (SC-09000-K1 through SC-09009-K1) sharing an identical device fingerprint with the flagged card SC-03014-K956 [EV-347737ac]. The device component contains four cards with confirmed fraud history, forming a fraud ring of 18 cards [EV-09d194d8]. The flagged transaction 4012206 ($755.25) received a high risk score of 0.75, far exceeding the card's typical transaction average of $3.95 [EV-43514a99, EV-9d3f5c32]. Four online transactions occurred on the flagged card within a 48-hour window, suggesting rapid-fire testing or monetization [EV-99de1297]. The customer denies authorizing the purchases and reports the physical card remains in their possession, consistent with card-not-present fraud [EV-5b504842]. A single prior case for this customer was cleared as legitimate, but the current pattern differs markedly [EV-1d3339df]. The total exposure across four transactions is $767.09. The undocumented pattern and device-linked fraud ring warrant SAR filing.
